Haa-Meem .
Aen-Seen-Qaaf
. ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah jo aziz o hakeem hai , tum per aur tum say pehlay jo ( payghumber ) huye hain , unn per issi tarah wahi nazil kerta hai .
jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai , sabb ussi ka hai , aur wohi hai jo bartari aur azmat ka malik hai .

aisa lagta hai kay aasman oopper say phatt parren gay ,   aur farishtay apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh ker rahey hain , aur zameen walon kay liye astaghfaar ker rahey hain . yaad rakho kay Allah hi hai jo boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
aur jinn logon  ney uss kay siwa doosray rakhwalay bana rakhay hain , Allah unn per nigrani rakhay huye hai , aur tum unn kay zimma daar nahi ho .

aur issi tarah hum ney yeh arbi Quran tum per wahi kay zariye bheja hai , takay tum markazi basti ( makkah ) aur uss kay irdgird walon ko uss din say khabrdar kero jiss mein sabb ko jama kiya jaye ga , jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi hai . aik giroh jannat mein jaye ga , aur aik giroh bharakti hoi aag mein .

aur agar Allah chahta to inn sabb ko aik hi jamat bana deta ,   lekin woh jiss ko chahta hai , apni rehmat mein dakhil kerta hai , aur jo zalim log hain , unn ka naa koi rakhwala hai , naa koi madadgaar .
kiya inn logon  ney uss ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalay bana liye hain-? sach to yeh hai kay rakhwala Allah hi hai , aur wohi murdon ko zinda kerta hai , aur wohi her cheez per qadir hai .

aur tum jiss baat mein bhi ikhtilaf kertay ho , uss ka faisla Allah hi kay supurd hai . logo ! wohi Allah hai jo mera perwerdigar hai . ussi per mein ney bharosa kiya hai , aur ussi say mein lo lagata hun .

woh aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai . uss ney tumharay liye tumhari hi jins say jooray peda kiye hain , aur maweshiyon kay bhi jooray banaye hain . issi zariye say woh tumhari nasal chalata hai . koi cheez uss kay misil nahi hai , aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , sabb kuch dekhta hai .
aasmano aur zameen ki sari kunjiyan ussi kay qabazay mein hain . woh jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq mein wusat aur tangi kerta hai , yaqeenan woh her cheez ka janney wala hai .

uss ney tumharay liye deen ka wohi tareeqa tey kiya hai jiss ka hukum uss ney nooh ko diya tha , aur jo ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumharay paas wahi kay zariye bheja hai aur jiss ka hukum hum ney Ibrahim , musa aur essa ko diya tha kay tum deen ko qaeem kero , aur uss mein tafarqa naa daalna . ( phir bhi ) mushrikeen ko woh baat boht giraan guzarti hai jiss ki taraf tum unhen dawat dey rahey ho . Allah jiss ko chahta hai , chunn ker apni taraf kheench leta hai , aur jo koi uss say lo lagata hai , ussay apney paas phoncha deta hai .

aur logon  ney aapas ki adawaton ki wajeh say ( deen mein ) jo tafarqa daala hai woh uss kay baad hi daala hai jab unn kay paas yaqeeni ilm aa-chuka tha . aur agar tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik moyyan mauddat tak kay liye aik baat pehlay say tey naa hoti to unn ka faisla hochuka hota .   aur inn logon  kay baad jinn ko kitab ka waris banaya gaya hai , woh uss kay baaray mein aesay shak mein parray huye hain jiss ney unhen khaljaan mein daal rakha hai .

lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum ussi baat ki taraf logon  ko dawat detay raho , aur jiss tarah tumhen hukum diya gaya hai , ( issi deen per ) jamay raho , aur inn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalo , aur keh do kay :  mein to uss kitab per emaan laya hun jo Allah ney nazil ki hai , aur mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay mein tumharay darmiyan insaf kerun . Allah humara bhi rab hai , aur tumhara bhi rab . humaray aemal humaray liye hain , aur tumharay aemal tumharay liye . humaray aur tumharay darmiyan ( abb ) koi behas nahi . Allah hum sabb ko jama keray ga , aur ussi kay paas aakhir sabb ko loattna hai .

aur jo log Allah kay baaray mein behasen nikaltay hain jabkay log uss ki baat maan chukay hain , unn ki behas unn kay perwerdigar kay nazdeek batil hai , aur unn per ( Allah ka ) ghazab hai , aur unn kay liye sakht azab .
Allah woh hai jiss ney haq per mushtamil yeh kitab aur insaf ki tarazoo utaari hai . aur tumhen kiya pata , shayad kay qayamat ki gharri qareeb hi ho .

jo log uss per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh uss kay aaney ki jaldi machatay hain , aur jo log emaan laye hain , woh uss say sehmay rehtay hain , aur jantay hain kay woh bar-haq hai . aray jo log qayamat kay baaray mein behasen ker rahey hain , woh gumrahi mein boht door chalay gaye hain .
Allah apney bandon per boht meharban hai , woh jiss ko chahta hai , rizq deta hai , aur wohi hai jo quooat ka bhi malik hai , iqtidar ka bhi malik .

jo shaks aakhirat ki kheti chahta ho , hum uss ki kheti mein aur izafa keren gay , aur jo shaks ( sirf ) duniya ki kheti chahta ho , hum ussay ussi mein say dey den gay ,   aur aakhirat mein uss ka koi hissa nahi .

kiya inn ( kafiron ) kay kuch aesay shareek hain jinhon ney inn kay liye aisa deen tey kerdiya hai jiss ki Allah ney ijazat nahi di hai ? aur agar ( Allah ki taraf say ) faisla kunn baat tey shuda naa hoti to inn ka moamla chuka diya gaya hota . aur yaqeen rakho kay inn zalimon kay liye bara dardnak azab hai .

. ( uss waqt ) tum inn zalimon ko dekho gay kay unhon ney jo kamai ki hai , uss ( kay wabal ) say sehmay huye hon gay , aur woh unn per parr ker rahey ga . aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , woh jannaton ki kiyariyon mein hon gay . unhen apney perwerdigar kay paas woh sabb kuch milay ga jo woh chahen gay . yehi bara fazal hai .

yehi woh cheez hai jiss ki khushkhabri Allah apney unn bandon ko deta hai jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain . ( aey payghumber ! kafiron say ) keh do kay :  mein tum say iss ( tableegh ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta , siwaye rishta daari ki mohabbat kay .    aur jo shaks koi bhalai keray ga , hum uss ki khatir uss bhalai mein mazeed khoobi ka izafa kerden gay .   yaqeen jano Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara qadardaan hai .

bhala kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay iss shaks ney yeh kalam khud gharr ker jhoot moott Allah kay zimmay laga diya hai ? halankay agar Allah chahye to tumharay dil per mohar laga dey , aur Allah to batil ko mitatta hai , aur haq ko apney kalmaat kay zariye sabit kerta hai .   yaqeenan woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton tak ko janta hai .
aur wohi hai jo apney bandon ki tauba qubool kerta hai , aur gunahon ko moaaf kerta hai , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , uss ka poora ilm rakhta hai .
aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , woh unn ki dua sunta hai , aur unhen apney fazal say aur ziyada deta hai . aur kafiron kay liye sakht azab hai .

aur agar Allah apney tamam bandon kay liye rizq ko khulay tor per phela deta to woh zameen mein sarkashi kernay lagtay , magar woh aik khaas andazay say jitna chahta hai ( rizq ) utaarta hai . yaqeenan woh apney bandon say poori tarah ba-khabar , unn per nazar rakhney wala hai .
aur wohi hai jo logon  kay naa umeed honey kay baad barish barsata aur apni rehmat phela deta hai , aur wohi hai jo ( sabb ka ) qabil-e-tareef rakhwala hai .
aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say hai aasmano aur zameen ki pedaeesh aur woh jandaar jo uss ney unn dono mein phela rakhay hain . aur woh jab chahye , unn ko jama kernay per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
aur tumhen jo koi museebat phonchti hai , woh tumharay apney haathon kiye huye kamon ki wajeh say phonchti hai , aur boht say kamon say to woh darguzar hi kerta hai .
aur tumhari majal nahi hai kay zameen mein ( Allah ko ) aajiz ker-sako , aur Allah kay siwa tumhara naa koi rakhwala hai , naa madadgaar .
aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say hain samandar mein yeh paharon jaisay jahaz !

agar woh chahye to hawa ko thehra dey , jiss say yeh samandar ki pusht per kharray kay kharray reh jayen yaqeenan iss mein her uss shaks kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo sabar ka bhi khoogar ho , shukar ka bhi
ya ( agar Allah Chahye ) to in jahazon ko logon kay baaz aemal ki wajeh sy tabah hi karday , aur boht son say darguzar kar jaye ,
aur jo log humari aayaton mein jhagray daaltay hain , unhen pata chal jaye kay unn kay liye koi bachao ki jagah nahi hai .

gharz tumhen jo koi cheez di gaee hai , woh dunyawi zindagi ki poonji hai , aur jo kuch Allah kay paas hai , woh unn logon  kay liye kahen behtar aur payedaar hai jo emaan laye hain , aur apney perwerdigar per bharosa kertay hain .
aur jo baray baray gunahon aur bey hayai kay kamon say perhez kertay hain , aur jab unn ko ghussa aata hai to woh darguzar say kaam letay hain .

aur jinhon ney apney perwerdigar ki baat maani hai , aur namaz qaeem ki hai , aur unn kay moamlaat aapas kay mashwaray say tey hotay hain , aur hum ney unhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say woh ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain ,
aur jab unn per koi ziyadti hoti hai to woh apna difaa kertay hain .
aur kissi burai ka badla ussi jaisi burai hai .   phir bhi jo koi moaaf kerday , aur islaah say kaam ley to uss ka sawab Allah ney zimmay liya hai . yaqeenan woh zalimon ko pasand nahi kerta .
aur jo shaks apney oopper zulm honey kay baad ( barabar ka ) badla ley to aesay logon  per koi ilzam nahi hai .
ilzam to unn per hai jo logon  per zulm kertay aur zameen mein nahaq ziyadtiyan kertay hain . aesay logon  kay liye dardnak azab hai .
aur yeh haqeeqat hai kay jo koi sabar say kaam ley , aur darguzar ker jaye to yeh bari himmat ki baat hai .

aur jissay Allah gumrah kerday , to uss kay baad koi nahi hai jo uss ka madadgaar banay . aur jab zalimon ko azab nazar aajaye ga to tum unhen yeh kehta huwa dekho gay kay :  kiya wapis janey ka bhi koi raasta hai-?

aur tum unhen dekho gay kay dozakh kay samney unhen iss tarah paish kiya jaye ga kay woh zillat kay maaray jhukay huye kinn ankhiyon say dekh rahey hon gay . aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain woh keh rahey hon gay kay :  waqaee asal khasaray mein woh log hain jinhon ney qayamat kay din apney aap ko aur apney ghar walon ko khasaray mein daal diya .  yaad rakho kay zalim log aesay azab mein hon gay jo hamesha qaeem rahey ga ,
aur unn ko aesay koi madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay jo Allah ko chorr ker unn ki koi madad keren . aur jissay Allah gumrah kerday , uss kay liye bachao ka koi raasta nahi hota .

. ( logo ! ) apney perwerdigar ki baat uss din kay aaney say pehlay pehlay maan lo jissay Allah ki taraf say taala nahi jaye ga . uss din tumharay liye koi jaye panah nahi hogi , aur naa tumharay liye pooch gich ka koi moaqa hoga .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh log agar phir bhi mun morren to hum ney tumhen inn per nigran bana ker nahi bheja hai . tum per baat phoncha denay kay siwa koi zimma daari nahi hai . aur ( insan ka haal yeh hai kay ) jab hum insan ko apni taraf say kissi rehmat ka maza chakha detay hain to woh uss per itra jata hai , aur agar khud apney haathon kay kartoot ki wajeh say aesay logon  ko koi museebat paish aajati hai to wohi insan paka nashukra ban jata hai .
saray aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat Allah hi ki hai . woh jo chahta hai , peda kerta hai . woh jiss ko chahta hai , larkiyan deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai , larkay deta hai ,
ya phir unn ko mila jula ker larkay bhi deta hai , aur larkiyan bhi , aur jiss ko chahta hai , baanjh bana deta hai . yaqeenan woh ilm ka bhi malik hai , qudrat ka bhi malik .

aur kissi insan mein yeh taqat nahi hai kay Allah uss say ( roobaroo ) baat keray ,   siwaye iss kay kay woh wahi kay zariye ho , ya kissi perday kay peechay say , ya phir woh koi paygham laney wala ( farishta ) bhej dey , aur woh uss kay hukum say jo woh chahye wahi ka paygham phoncha dey . yaqeenan woh boht oonchi shaan wala , bari hikmat ka malik hai .

aur issi tarah hum ney tumharay paas apney hukum say aik rooh bator wahi nazil ki hai .   tumhen iss say pehlay naa yeh maloom tha kay kitab kiya hoti hai , aur naa yeh kay emaan kiya hai , lekin hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko aik noor banaya hai jiss kay zariye hum apney bandon mein say jiss ko chahtay hain , hidayat detay hain . aur iss mein koi shak nahi kay tum logon  ko woh seedha raasta dikha rahey ho

jo Allah ka raasta hai , woh Allah jiss ki milkiyat mein woh sabb kuch hai jo aasmano mein hai , aur woh sabb kuch jo zameen mein hai . yaad rakho kay saray moamlaat aakhir kaar Allah hi ki taraf loten gay .
